concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-settle-funds]] — 2026-09-15 Platforms sales-day net-settlement guide for captured-batch timing, contract/custom delays, pass-through deprecation and 30-day reversal; settled balance is not bank receipt.
warnings: Pass-through settlement is deprecated for new integrations except stated Affirm and maestro_USA variants; the page does not prove current exception eligibility.
If funds have not reached Adyen within 30 days after capture, reversed settlement subtracts them from the current batch.
Settlement and payout are separate stages; dated timing examples and settled balance do not prove beneficiary bank receipt.
